chunk 7 "Take stock of what you sent off" lines 98-104: "Three agents, each with one job... Each will be waiting when Day 2 starts, written in your company's look" is a self-carrying claim. Smallest chunk is chunk 2 (lines 25-33), a full instruction with prompt and a check.

chunk 6 "Phase 6: Check the look, then close it" lines 84-94: body checks the look (line 92) and leaves latest.html unopened (line 94); the header does not contradict the content. Chunk 5 "Schedule it" matches lines 69-82.

grep for "Not X. Not Y. Z." shape: none. Closest, line 17 "One job, not three." is a single contrast, not a triple. Line 17 "The product owner might... The designer might... The team lead might..." is a triple but each leg carries new concrete content. Line 100 "each with one job, each reading" is a pair. No superlatives, no number+retraction, no abstraction stacks, no empty verb triplets.
